canonical_name: No Inventory of Information and Associated Assets
description: Organization lacks a maintained inventory of information assets and associated assets with identified owners.
applicability: Applies when an organization cannot identify all information assets, lacks documentation of asset ownership, or does not maintain an up-to-date inventory of hardware, software, data, and other information-related assets.

metadata.detection_notes: Request asset inventory documentation, verify asset ownership assignments, assess inventory update frequency, check for automated asset discovery tools, review asset classification and criticality ratings.
